title: Named Non-Owner Policy Late Renewal: Lapse-Length Relativity Schedule
content:
| Days of lapse on the renewal term | Relativity on the late-renewal written premium |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 1.12 |
| 3 to 5 | 1.06 |
| 1 or 2 | none |

**Counting the lapse.** For a Named Non-Owner Policy renewal term accepted after expiration, the lapse days are counted from the first lapse day attested on the latest Statement of No Loss signed for the renewal term through the last lapse day recorded on the renewal term, both days included. When two such statements share the latest document date, the one recorded first is read. A lapse with no such statement counts no days, and no relativity applies to it.

**Effect.** The relativity in the schedule multiplies the late-renewal written premium before that premium is rounded to the cent; a lapse of one or two days, or one counting no days, carries no such relativity.

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical).**

| Statement attests first lapse day | Last lapse day recorded | Days counted | Relativity |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 June | 4 June | 2 | none |
| 3 June | 5 June | 3 | 1.06 |
| 3 June | 7 June | 5 | 1.06 |
| 3 June | 8 June | 6 | 1.12 |

*Two statements:* one dated 9 June attesting a first lapse day of 2 June and one dated 11 June attesting 4 June; the one dated 11 June is the latest, so counting starts on 4 June.
